name: Translate
description: Translate messages with Google Translate, DeepL or Kagi.

settings.label: Received input
settings.description: Language incoming messages are translated from

settings.label: Received output
settings.description: Language incoming messages are translated to

settings.label: Sent input
settings.description: Language your messages are translated from

settings.label: Sent output
settings.description: Language your messages are translated to

settings.label: DeepL API Key
settings.description: Your DeepL API key (from deepl.com/your-account). Only used with DeepL; kept in the system keychain

settings.label: Kagi Session
settings.description: Your Kagi session token (from kagi.com/settings?p=user_details). Only used with Kagi; kept in the system keychain

settings.label: Auto Translate
settings.description: Automatically translate your messages before sending. You can also Shift+click or right-click the translate button to toggle this

settings.label: Show auto translate tooltip
settings.description: Show a tooltip on the chat bar button when a message is auto-translated

notes: "Translate" in a message's menu shows the translation under it ("translated from X - Dismiss"). The chat bar button opens the languages window (searchable lists for the received and sent languages, and Auto Translate); Shift+click or right-click toggles auto-translate, with upstream's notice the first time. With auto-translate on, a message waits in the locked message box until it is translated, with "Auto Translate Enabled" over the button for two seconds. Google needs no key; DeepL (free or pro, falling back to Google when the quota runs out) and Kagi take an API key or session token, which Qord keeps in the system keychain instead of the settings file.
gaps: No translate button in a message's hover bar (Qord has no message popover hook yet); use the message menu.
A failed auto-translation leaves the text in the message box instead of sending it untranslated as upstream does.
The settings page has no button for the languages window; it opens from the chat bar button.
The DeepL key and Kagi session fields show whatever service is chosen.
